# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_ALIGNMENT_BOS_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A bullish EMA ribbon (EMA_8 > EMA_13 > EMA_21 > EMA_34) aligned with a break-of-structure above the prior swing high confirms strong continuation momentum. This edge exists because ribbon alignment indicates established trend direction, while BOS with volume expansion signals institutional participation and reduced likelihood of immediate reversal.

## Mechanism

Entry: When ribbon is bullishly stacked for ≥2 consecutive bars AND price makes a new higher high breaking the prior swing high (BOS) with volume > 1.3×20-bar average volume, enter long at close of breakout bar.  
Exit: Initial chart-stop at prior swing low (structure invalidation), TP1 at 2R from entry, runner trailed 25% off high-water mark after TP1 hit.  
Regime filters: Avoid first 15 min and last 30 min of session; require ribbon slope >0 and ribbon width (EMA_8-EMA_34) < 0.8×ATR(14) to avoid choppy markets.
